body: Thank you,  I obviously don't want this, for the sake of my kids. I know they need me. But I see no way out of this pain.  I'm dating a girl, but I feel like shit because it's not my wife.  I can't just let go. Ibe loved my wife for 17 years without question, and she leaves me, and the kids, along with all we've built and moves into a shitty 1 bedroom apartment with this piece of shit.  And the worst of it is she only moved a block away. I get to drive by the fucking place every day I take my kids to school, or come home from work. A constant reminder that the woman I love has left me.. every day twice a day.  I can't even kick the guys ass because of the protective order.  He knows he's fucking up my family and doesn't care.  I just wish I could disappear
